summary: National Fuel Gas Company furnished an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing that its board approved a plan to separate the company into two independent, publicly traded companies via a tax-free spin-off of the Integrated Upstream and Gathering business. The split is targeted for completion in the second half of calendar year 2027, subject to a Form 10 registration statement filing and effectiveness, completion of financing arrangements, customary conditions, and final board approval. No stake, price, premium, or advisor is stated. Watch the Form 10, financings, and any REIT- or utility-structure overhang as the timeline develops.
